_about: Keyword plan for the shadinotatech.com blog (CardCraft – ID Card Maker cluster). Research: 2026-11-15. Head terms like 'id card maker' are dominated by big tool pages (Canva, Fotor, Kittl, Pixlr), so the plan targets long-tail, practical 'how to' and spec queries where real product experience (A4 print sheets, 300 DPI, bulk Excel import, Bangladesh print market) gives an edge. Publish in order; set status to 'published' with the date and slug when done. Pillar = how-to-make-id-cards-on-your-phone; every cluster post links to the pillar and to 1-2 siblings.
